info.name: Ticketing Service
info.description:
Postman collection for the Ticketing microservice (Laravel 11 API-only). All endpoints under /api/v1.

## Auth

Most endpoints require a JWT (HS256) issued by the admin service. Two routes are public: `GET /health` and `POST /public/tickets` (the customer submission form).

Generate a dev token:
```
php scripts/jwt.php 1 "Osama" "developers@intcore.com"
```
Paste it into the `token` collection variable.

## Rate limits

Three named limiters are wired up — every response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit` / `X-RateLimit-Remaining` headers showing the inner-most limit for that route:

| Limiter         | Scope                                  | Limit          | Key                                                  |
|-----------------|----------------------------------------|----------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `api`           | Every `/api/*` route (Laravel default) | 60 / minute    | client IP                                            |
| `admin`         | All authenticated routes               | 120 / minute   | admin id from JWT (falls back to IP at 30/min)       |
| `public-tickets`| `POST /public/tickets` only            | 10 / minute    | client IP                                            |

When exceeded, endpoints return `429 Too Many Requests` with `{"message":"Too Many Attempts."}`.

request.description:
Public ticket submission for end customers (web contact form, WhatsApp gateway, etc.).

**Constraints**
- No JWT — call without `Authorization`.
- At least one of `email` or `phone` is required (so the customer can be contacted).
- `platform` is restricted to `web` or `whatsapp`. Defaults to `web`.
- Server-controlled fields are ignored if sent: `admin_id`, `status`, `created_by`, `ticket_category_id`, `sub_category_id`, `sub_sub_category_id`, `type_id`. The ticket is always created with `status=new`, `created_by=null`, `admin_id=null`.
- `category_id` / `season_id` / `zone_id` are optional but FK-checked when provided.
- Multipart with `attachments[]` accepted (max 5 files, 10 MB each).
- Rate limited to 10 submissions per minute per IP.

query.description: Single value, OR repeat as status[]=new&status[]=assigned for multi. Values: new | assigned | in_progress | pending_customer | resolved | closed. Invalid values are silently dropped.
Add more status[] entries to OR-match multiple statuses
Shortcut: 'me' (current JWT admin) or 'unassigned'. Overrides admin_id when set.
Filter by category. With include_subcategories=1 walks the tree.
Include tickets in descendants of category_id (any depth)
Only tickets that have ≥1 internal note
Free-text across subject, description, ticket_number, first_name, last_name, email, phone
Only soft-deleted tickets (takes precedence over with_trashed)

request.description:
Paginated admin-dashboard listing with rich filters, free-text search, and sort.

**Filter combinations are AND**, except `status[]` which OR-matches within itself. Invalid filter values (e.g. `status[]=garbage`) are silently dropped so a bad UI checkbox never crashes the request.

**Free-text `q`** searches: `subject`, `description`, `ticket_number`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `email`, `phone`.

**Category tree**: `category_id=N` matches that exact category. Pair with `include_subcategories=1` to also match every descendant (any depth — uses `parent_id` chain).

**Sort options**:
- `latest` (default) — newest id first
- `oldest`
- `updated` — most recently changed
- `closed`  — most recently closed (nulls effectively last)

Each item includes media + counts (`replies_count`, `notes_count`) and admin objects resolved from the admin service.

request.description: Partial update. Allowed: subject, description, customer fields, status, platform, occurrence_time, is_valid, all *_id taxonomy fields. To change assignment use POST /assign instead.
Soft-deletes the ticket (sets `deleted_at`). Cascade deletes its replies, notes, and media.

Single endpoint for every status transition. Body must include `status` (one of `new` | `assigned` | `in_progress` | `pending_customer` | `resolved` | `closed`). When `status=assigned`, `admin_id` is required.

Side effects (auto-applied based on target status):
- `assigned` → sets `admin_id`, stamps `assigned_at`, clears `closed_at`
- `closed` → stamps `closed_at`
- any other (from a closed ticket) → clears `closed_at`

response.name: 422 admin_id required when assigning

request.description: Closes the ticket: stamps `closed_at = now()`.

Use any non-closed status to reopen a closed ticket — `closed_at` is cleared automatically. The body status can be any of: `new`, `assigned` (requires `admin_id`), `in_progress`, `pending_customer`, `resolved`, `closed`.

item.name: Seasons
item.description: CRUD for seasons. `name` is multilingual (Spatie Translatable). Cover image is uploaded as a single file via Spatie MediaLibrary on the `cover` collection.

query.description: Substring match on the JSON name column

request.description: `name` is an object keyed by locale. At least one of `name.en` / `name.ar` must be provided. `status` defaults to `true`.

response.name: 422 Validation

request.description: Send as `multipart/form-data` with a single `cover` file (image, ≤20 MB). The file is stored on the `cover` Spatie media collection (single file — replaces any existing cover).
Partial update. Sending only `name.ar` patches the Arabic translation without touching English (Spatie Translatable merges per-locale). Use `remove_cover: true` to clear the cover.
Soft delete — sets `deleted_at`. Excluded from list by default; pass `with_trashed=1` on `GET /seasons` to include.

item.name: Zones
item.description: CRUD for zones. `name` is multilingual. Each zone belongs to a season (`season_id` is required and FK-checked). Cascading: deleting a season hard-deletes its zones, and deleting a zone hard-deletes its categories.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: `season_id` is required and must reference an existing season.

response.name: 422 missing season_id

request.description: Returns the zone with its `season` (eager-loaded) and `categories` array + `categories_count`.
Partial update. Re-assigning to a different `season_id` is allowed.
Soft delete (sets `deleted_at`). Pass `with_trashed=1` on list to surface.

item.name: Categories
item.description: CRUD for categories. `name` is multilingual (Spatie Translatable). `parent_id` is a self-FK so categories form a tree. `zone_id` is a real FK to `zones` (nullable, cascade on delete).

query.description: Filter to direct children of this parent
Only top-level categories (parent_id IS NULL). Ignored if parent_id is given.

response.name: 200 OK (tree)

request.description: Top-level category — omit `parent_id`. `zone_id` is optional in this microservice (no FK).
Child category — `parent_id` must reference an existing category. The hierarchy can go arbitrarily deep.
Returns the category with eager-loaded direct `children` and a `children_count`.
Partial update. A category cannot become its own parent (`parent_id` cannot equal the category's own id — server enforces with a 422).

response.name: 422 self-parent

request.description: Soft delete. Children stay (their `parent_id` still references the soft-deleted row); pass `with_trashed=1` on list to surface them.
